title: Review of c51's chiral eating flocks negative: on fresh seeds 7 and 8 and at world dt/2, chi 0.03 gives churning crescents (longest track 20-21 frames = 200 t, 0 persistent splits, 780-851 nucleations), chi 0.06 churns, chi 0.1 gives still splitting spots (3 persistent splits, gen 2, max 0.8 body lengths)
summary: Re-ran the author's world with labkit as in runs.sh on fresh seeds: chi 0.03 (threshold 0.45) seeds 7 and 8, chi 0.03 at world dt 0.125 (spf 80) seed 7, chi 0.06 and chi 0.1 seed 7, T=3000 each. chi 0.03: 0 persistent tracks, longest 20/21 frames, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.74/0.75, nucleations 851/851, 1-2 tracks moved >= 1 body length; dt/2: longest 21 frames, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.70, 780 nucleations. chi 0.06: longest 17 frames, 0 persistent splits, merge/split 0.83. chi 0.1: round spots, 3 persistent tracks, 3 persistent splits, generation 2, max 0.8 body lengths moved. The finding's numbers and its reading (crescents are re-igniting wave fragments; high chirality gives still Gray-Scott-like spots) reproduce.

observations.finding: chi03_s7/seed7/sheet.png t=130-3000: crescent hooks with pink polarized fronts and pale wakes that break, merge and re-form; FACTS: longest track 20 frames, 0 persistent splits, 851 nucleations. chi10_s7/sheet.png t=1000-3000: round still spots packed over the domain; FACTS: 3 persistent splits, generation 2, max 0.8 body lengths.

verdicts.limitation: One grid (128^2), kinetics fixed at the parent's spot point; I re-ran 3 of the 6 chirality points on fresh seeds, and the dt/2 test only at chi 0.03. A negative over a 1-D scan does not exclude motile individuals at other kinetics.
